items.title: Drivers brace for petrol price hikes as fuel excise cut comes to end
items.description: Prices are forecast to increase to about $2.20 a litre for unleaded and $2.60 a litre for diesel when the fuel excise returns to its normal rate.

items.title: How a factually dubious video by Ivanka Trump angered an entire nation
items.description: Albania's coastline has become a hotspot for cheap European summer sojourns but as Ivanka Trump claims her Christopher Columbus moment, locals are adamant that their island is not for sale.

items.title: Trump holds off on new strikes against Iran amid emerging 'deal'
items.description: Donald Trump says the US will hold off on fresh strikes against Iran, as Middle East allies have agreed to parameters of a deal to end the war.

items.title: Live: Eels scores late to break Tigers hearts with three-point win
items.description: The Parramatta Eels have taken a half-time lead over the Wests Tigers, after being denied a try by a rare knock-on which ABC Sport's Matthew Elliott says he has "never seen before". Follow live.

items.title: Live: Eagles star in tears after loss to Tigers, Dees pip Suns in thriller
items.description: No.1 pick Willem Duursma breaks down after West Coast's loss to Richmond at the MCG as Melbourne records a huge road win against Gold Coast. Follow live.

items.title: Garma land council announcement sparks concern in region
items.description: A key clan elder on the Gove Peninsula has voiced his frustration, confusion and concern over a bold plan to create a new Aboriginal land council in his region.

items.title: Australia records biggest-ever surge in EV sales
items.description: Nearly one in every two new vehicles sold was either electric or hybrid across April, May and June.

items.title: Eighteen days in a Japanese police cell killed our daughter, family says
items.description: A 16-year-old girl's family alleges she was so traumatised by her time in a police cell, it killed her. Her case is now the focus of court action alleging she was a victim of Japan's "hostage justice" system.

items.title: Quick hits: Sprinter's surprise, a bored prince and a stunning upset
items.description: Prince George looks utterly disinterested, Jamaican netballers celebrate and Australian sprinter's surprise visit. Here are the quick hits from day nine of the Commonwealth Games.

items.title: The US may have reached 'turning point' in school shooting punishments
items.description: For the third time in US history, a parent has been held criminally responsible for the murderous actions of their child. Legal experts have suggested it marks a turning point for American prosecutors.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
